items.text: — clean stable channel for daily CPU, temperature, battery, GPU, and RAM monitoring on Apple Silicon.
— OpenAI (GPT) + OpenRouter only (bring your own keys).
— App ZIP recommended (no admin password); PKG/DMG/.sh also available.
— ⌘Q now quits the menu bar app (accessory policy previously ignored Quit).
— everything in Beta, plus duel, ghost-load, SOC budget, meeting cloak, polite peer, AirDrop card, desktop widget, confession, alibi, presets.
— expect breakage; for people who want the full playground.
— ⌘Q now quits the menu bar app (accessory policy previously ignored Quit).
— weather, detective, whisper, compile-farm, time-scrub, power receipt. Toys moved to Experimental.
— real macOS captures of Monitor, Advisors, Chat, Cleaner, Settings, and Benchmark.
— releases on github.com/ilikemacos/rNitro with App ZIP, PKG, DMG, and .sh.

releases.title: v1.2.4 Beta / Experimental
releases.body_html: Patched a bug — ⌘Q now quits the menu bar app. Lab crash fix (scrub slider) + Experimental Features sidebar. GitHub.

releases.title: v1.2.3 Beta
releases.body_html: Beta — Lab: AirDrop card, SOC budget, cooling confession, desktop widget, rnitro lab status. GitHub.

releases.title: v1.1.0 Final Reloaded
releases.body_html: Stable channel — production-ready menu bar monitor for daily use. AI limited to OpenAI + OpenRouter. Latest release on GitHub.

releases.title: Platform notes
releases.body_html: macOS — Apple Silicon, macOS 12+. Linux — v0.1 pre-release on the Linux tab. Windows — deprecated; last builds remain for download only.

compare.title: Stable vs Beta — which should I download?
compare.subtitle: New here? Start with the green Recommended Download (App ZIP). v1.1.0 Final Reloaded is production-ready; v1.2.1 Beta adds every AI provider. See the Linux and Windows pages for other platforms.
